finding.summary: [P1] Require reported usage before raising the session mark (apps/core/src/runtime/group-agent-runner-context-ceiling.ts:49): `raiseProviderSessionMarkFromOutput` treats `contextUsage.totalTokens` as sufficient and prefers it over `modelVisibleInputTokens(output.usage)`.

rejected_findings.reason: Decision 0158 section 2 states the observed value IS contextUsage.totalTokens when the run reports it, and modelVisibleInputTokens derived from normalised usage ONLY when it does not; the confirmed spec repeats it at docs/specs/cache-bug.md:73. The implementation follows that precedence exactly, and AGENTS.md makes docs/decisions authoritative over conflicting guidance, so inverting it would put the code in breach of an accepted decision. T2-AC1 does not require otherwise: its sentence describes the S4 errored-run case, where a run that died mid-turn has no contextUsage and the usage-derived figure is the only measurement available. It never forbids contextUsage; reading a prohibition into it is an inference rather than its text. AC1's second clause, that a run reporting no usage must not call the operation, is honoured — the mark resolves to undefined only when BOTH contextUsage and usage are absent, and the raise returns early on undefined, so the repository is never called without a measurement. An output carrying contextUsage HAS reported one. The reviewer's substantive worry, that a provider's own context snapshot could read lower than the cache-inclusive input count, is real but is the tradeoff 0158 section 2 weighed and accepted, on the grounds that the provider's snapshot is authoritative about its own context size; re-deciding it inside T2 would overturn an accepted decision through a review finding. For the record, AC1's wording is narrower than 0158 and invited this reading, which is a defect in the criterion I authored rather than in the code.

finding.summary: T2-AC1: S4 post-run raise: a run that ends in error but reported usage raises the mark through raiseProviderSessionContextHighWaterMark with the model-visible input tokens T1 computes; a run that reported no usage does not call the operation at all (not with zero, not with undefined).

rejected_findings.reason: Same rejection as the P1 it maps to: T2-AC1 is satisfied under decision 0158 section 2, which makes contextUsage.totalTokens the observed value when the run reports it and modelVisibleInputTokens the fallback when it does not. AC1's sentence describes the S4 errored-run case, where no contextUsage exists and the usage-derived figure is the only measurement; its no-usage clause is honoured because the mark resolves to undefined only when both measurements are absent and the raise returns early. The criterion's wording is narrower than the decision it derives from — a defect in the text I authored, not in the implementation — and docs/decisions is authoritative over conflicting guidance per AGENTS.md. Correcting the criterion text is recorded as a deferral rather than done here, because amending acceptance_criteria changes the contract digest and would stale this task's grill and approval mid-stage.
